Definition: from G1418 and a derivative of G941; oppressive:--grievous to be borne.
BiblicalUsage: Hard to bear, as Jesus charged the lawyers with loading men with burdens grievous to be borne, burdens they would not touch with one of their fingers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the burdens men load on others are the opposite of Christ's yoke, because His yoke is easy and His burden is light.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
